test_name: Supply Chain Risk Management - SR-11 with Critical Cross-Cutting Failure
architecture:
System: Audit-Lake-199
Primary NIST family: Supply Chain Risk Management (SR); evidence focus: SR-11.
Family control evidence: critical suppliers are periodically assessed for supply-chain risk and corrective actions are tracked. Critical observed condition: an internal API transmits credentials over plaintext HTTP with TLS disabled. Other controls may be configured correctly, but the observed condition is current production evidence.
